description: D-393 pressure fixture (D-321 child) - deliberately grows old-gen heap past its declared 32MB budget at ~40MB/s while staying responsive (probeStat keeps answering). Tests the tooling/watchdog memory leg: must be caught before threatening the process, with measured time-to-detection.

capabilities.justification: Self-contained grower: exercises the watchdog memory leg without needing cross-compartment calls.
